title: SB029 · A burning boat (source scene 23B)
subtitle: Emotion Concern · one shot, 10 s · reshoot in Aswanth's night look, follows s23-sh01 v6 · Ranjith, 2026-11-13

panels.title: Start: behind Antony's head, the far light ahead
beats: 0-2 s hold, 35mm, 1.2 m behind his head; the tiny light straight ahead (as SB028 ended).
2-7 s push 1 m over his right shoulder, lens 35 to 85mm; the light becomes a boat on the horizon; 4 s the fire flares along the hull, smoke starts; 3 s his breath stops, 6 s his hand tightens.

panels.title: End: the burning vallam, still 500 m
beats: 7-10 s hold: his shoulder soft at the left; the boat a twentieth of the frame on the horizon, flames along it, plume leaning right, narrow reflection. Silent.

panels.title: 3D blocking: who stands where
beats: Antony at the rail by the deckhouse front corner; the burning vallam 500 m ahead-left; camera starts 1.2 m behind his head and pushes 1 m over his right shoulder; the lantern and the sleeping crew stay behind and out of frame.
